name: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
author: rexmhall09
description: Detailed map of the official 11-jurisdiction Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Version 3 replaces the synthetic worker share with 48,744,750 government-controlled workplace jobs, including all 18 Hong Kong TPEDM districts, while retaining seven airport attractions and 48 university clusters.
data_source: 2023 Guangdong Fifth Economic Census, 2021 Hong Kong TPEDM, 2023 Macao employment statistics, official GBA population statistics, CAAC, HK UGC, Macao GCS, and OpenStreetMap
